title.en: Unit 8 Notes — Sewage Treatment and Disposal
title.gu: યુનિટ 8 Notes — Sewage Treatment અને Disposal

body.en:
Characteristics:

  • Physical: colour, odour, temperature, suspended solids and settleable matter.
  • Chemical: pH, dissolved oxygen, organic matter, nutrients, salts and potentially toxic industrial constituents.
  • Biological: bacteria, viruses, protozoa and other organisms; faecal indicators indicate contamination.

Grab samples represent a particular moment; time- or flow-composite samples represent a period and purpose. Plan the location, sampling frequency, preservation, temperature, transport, holding time and chain of custody with the laboratory. Use appropriate PPE and avoid exposure.

BOD estimates oxygen consumed by biological oxidation under a defined laboratory test; specify temperature and incubation time, e.g. BOD₅ at 20°C where prescribed. COD estimates oxygen equivalent of chemically oxidisable material by a specified digestion method. COD is generally higher than BOD for the same sample but method and sample interferences matter. Do not interchange their results.
body.gu:
Characteristics:

  • Physical: colour, odour, temperature, suspended solids અને settleable matter.
  • Chemical: pH, dissolved oxygen, organic matter, nutrients, salts અને સંભવિત toxic industrial constituents.
  • Biological: bacteria, viruses, protozoa અને અન્ય organisms; faecal indicators contamination બતાવે છે.

Grab sample ચોક્કસ ક્ષણ દર્શાવે છે; time- અથવા flow-composite sample સમયગાળો અને હેતુ દર્શાવે છે. Laboratory સાથે location, sampling frequency, preservation, temperature, transport, holding time અને chain of custody નક્કી કરો. યોગ્ય PPE વાપરી exposure ટાળો.

BOD નિર્દિષ્ટ laboratory test હેઠળ biological oxidation થી વપરાતા oxygen નો અંદાજ છે; temperature અને incubation time દર્શાવો, જેમ કે નિર્દિષ્ટ હોય ત્યાં BOD₅ at 20°C. COD નિર્દિષ્ટ digestion method વડે chemically oxidisable material નું oxygen equivalent દર્શાવે છે. સમાન sample માં COD સામાન્ય રીતે BOD કરતાં વધારે છે, પરંતુ method અને interferences મહત્વનાં છે. બંને results એકબીજાના સ્થાને ન વાપરો.

body.en:
Construction, working and purpose:

  • Screen: bars or mesh intercept rags, plastics and large objects at the inlet; screenings are removed mechanically and disposed safely.
  • Grit chamber: controlled flow allows heavy sand and grit to settle while limiting organic deposition; grit is removed and washed/disposed as required.
  • Skimming tank: floating oil, grease and scum are retained or floated and removed from the surface.
  • Primary sedimentation tank: reduced velocity allows settleable solids to sink; sludge is collected from the bottom and scum from the surface.

Preliminary and primary treatment reduce loads on downstream units but do not reliably make sewage safe for discharge or reuse.
body.gu:
Construction, working અને purpose:

  • Screen: inlet પર bars અથવા mesh rags, plastics અને મોટા પદાર્થો રોકે છે; screenings યાંત્રિક રીતે દૂર કરી સલામત disposal કરો.
  • Grit chamber: controlled flow માં ભારે sand અને grit બેસે છે અને organic deposition મર્યાદિત રહે છે; grit દૂર કરી જરૂરી washing/disposal કરો.
  • Skimming tank: ઉપર તરતું oil, grease અને scum રોકી અથવા float કરીને surface પરથી દૂર થાય છે.
  • Primary sedimentation tank: velocity ઓછી થતાં settleable solids નીચે બેસે છે; bottom થી sludge અને surface થી scum એકત્ર થાય છે.

Preliminary અને primary treatment downstream units પરનો load ઘટાડે છે, પણ sewage ને discharge અથવા reuse માટે વિશ્વસનીય રીતે safe બનાવતી નથી.

items.syllabus_item: 8.3 aeration trickling filter activated sludge digester

body.en:
Processes:

  • Aeration: transfers oxygen to wastewater and mixes it; supports aerobic biological treatment and can strip some gases.
  • Trickling filter: wastewater is distributed over fixed media; attached microbial biofilm consumes organic matter. Effluent goes to secondary clarification to settle sloughed biomass. It is not a drinking-water filter.
  • Activated sludge process: wastewater mixes with microbial flocs in an aeration tank; secondary clarifier separates biomass. Part is returned as return activated sludge and excess is wasted for sludge treatment.
  • Sludge digester: controlled anaerobic digestion stabilises sludge and produces biogas, which needs safe handling. Digested sludge still requires suitable treatment, monitoring and lawful disposal or reuse.

Effluent may need further nutrient removal, filtration and disinfection depending on the receiving environment and legal limits. Process selection requires power, skilled operation, odour control and a residuals-management plan.
body.gu:
Processes:

  • Aeration: wastewater માં oxygen transfer અને mixing કરે છે; aerobic biological treatment ને ટેકો આપે અને કેટલાક gases દૂર કરી શકે.
  • Trickling filter: wastewater fixed media પર વહેંચાય છે; attached microbial biofilm organic matter વાપરે છે. છૂટેલા biomass ને બેસાડવા effluent secondary clarification માં જાય છે. આ drinking-water filter નથી.
  • Activated sludge process: aeration tank માં wastewater microbial flocs સાથે મિશ્ર થાય છે; secondary clarifier biomass અલગ કરે છે. થોડો ભાગ return activated sludge તરીકે પાછો અને વધારાનો sludge treatment માટે દૂર થાય છે.
  • Sludge digester: controlled anaerobic digestion sludge ને સ્થિર કરે છે અને biogas ઉત્પન્ન કરે છે, જેનું સલામત handling જરૂરી છે. Digested sludge માટે પણ યોગ્ય treatment, monitoring અને કાયદેસર disposal અથવા reuse જરૂરી છે.

Receiving environment અને legal limits પ્રમાણે effluent ને વધુ nutrient removal, filtration અને disinfection જરૂરી હોઈ શકે. Process પસંદગીમાં power, skilled operation, odour control અને residuals-management plan જરૂરી છે.

h.en: 8.4 Disposal, septic tanks and soak pits
h.gu: 8.4 Disposal, septic tanks અને soak pits

items.syllabus_item: 8.5 8.6 septic tank soak pit disposal design

body.en:
Disposal and reuse: discharge to a water body or land only after the required treatment and with authority permission; protect groundwater, aquatic life and downstream users. Reuse must meet the standard for the intended exposure.

Septic tank: a watertight chamber provides settling, scum retention and anaerobic digestion; inlet and outlet arrangements reduce disturbance and retain solids. It is primary treatment, not complete disinfection. Provide access, ventilation, structural integrity and mechanised desludging.

Soak pit: a subsurface infiltration structure receives appropriately pretreated effluent where soil permeability, groundwater separation and local setbacks permit. It is not suitable in every soil or high-water-table site; assess percolation, contamination risk, flooding and legal requirements. Alternatives include dispersion trenches or further treatment.

Preliminary sizing: estimate daily wastewater flow, hydraulic retention and sludge/scum storage for the desludging interval; select internal dimensions and freeboard, then check IS 2470 Parts 1–2 and applicable local requirements for detailed capacity, compartments, inlet/outlet, construction, siting and effluent disposal. Never enter a tank to inspect or clean it; use authorised mechanised service.
body.gu:
Disposal અને reuse: જરૂરી treatment અને authority permission પછી જ water body અથવા land પર discharge કરો; groundwater, aquatic life અને downstream users નું રક્ષણ કરો. Reuse એ ઇચ્છિત exposure માટેનો standard સંતોષવો જોઈએ.

Septic tank: Watertight chamber settling, scum retention અને anaerobic digestion આપે છે; inlet અને outlet arrangements disturbance ઘટાડે તથા solids રોકે છે. આ primary treatment છે, સંપૂર્ણ disinfection નથી. Access, ventilation, structural integrity અને mechanised desludging આપો.

Soak pit: Soil permeability, groundwater separation અને local setbacks મંજૂરી આપે ત્યાં subsurface infiltration structure યોગ્ય pretreated effluent સ્વીકારે છે. દરેક soil અથવા high-water-table site માટે યોગ્ય નથી; percolation, contamination risk, flooding અને legal requirements તપાસો. Dispersion trenches અથવા વધુ treatment વિકલ્પો છે.

Preliminary sizing: Daily wastewater flow, hydraulic retention અને desludging interval માટે sludge/scum storage નો અંદાજ લો; internal dimensions અને freeboard પસંદ કરી detailed capacity, compartments, inlet/outlet, construction, siting અને effluent disposal માટે IS 2470 Parts 1–2 તથા local requirements તપાસો. Inspection અથવા cleaning માટે tank માં કદી પ્રવેશ ન કરો; authorised mechanised service વાપરો.

title.en: Numerical 8.1 — BOD of a diluted sample

body.en:
Given: An unseeded 300 mL BOD bottle contains 15 mL sample. Initial DO is 8.0 mg/L and DO after five days at 20°C is 4.0 mg/L. Assume negligible dilution-water blank and no nitrification correction.

Step 1. Calculate the dilution fraction.

P = sample volume / bottle volumeP = 15 / 300P = 0.05

Step 2. Calculate DO depletion and BOD.

DO depletion = 8.0 − 4.0DO depletion = 4.0 mg/LBOD₅ = DO depletion / PBOD₅ = 4.0 / 0.05

Final answer:

BOD₅ at 20°C = 80 mg/L under the stated assumptions.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: Unseeded 300 mL BOD bottle માં 15 mL sample છે. Initial DO 8.0 mg/L અને 20°C પર પાંચ દિવસ પછી DO 4.0 mg/L છે. Dilution-water blank અને nitrification correction નગણ્ય ધારો.

Step 1. Dilution fraction ગણો.

P = sample volume / bottle volumeP = 15 / 300P = 0.05

Step 2. DO depletion અને BOD ગણો.

DO depletion = 8.0 − 4.0DO depletion = 4.0 mg/LBOD₅ = DO depletion / PBOD₅ = 4.0 / 0.05

અંતિમ જવાબ:

આપેલ assumptions હેઠળ 20°C પર BOD₅ = 80 mg/L.

body.en:
Given: A COD test uses a 10 mL sample. Blank FAS titre is 10 mL, sample titre is 6 mL, and standardised FAS normality is 0.1 N. Calculate COD.

Step 1. Find the titre difference.

A − B = 10 − 6A − B = 4 mL

Step 2. Apply the COD expression.

COD = (A − B) × N × 8000 / sample volumeCOD = 4 × 0.1 × 8000 / 10

Final answer:

COD = 320 mg/L as oxygen equivalent for the stated test.

title.gu: Numerical 8.3 — Septic tank capacity નો preliminary અંદાજ

body.en:
Given: For 10 people assume wastewater flow 80 L/person/day, hydraulic retention 1 day and sludge/scum storage allowance 0.04 m³/person/year for 2 years. Estimate preliminary liquid volume; select internal liquid dimensions 2 m × 1 m × 1 m.

Step 1. Find daily flow and retention volume.

Q = 10 × 80Q = 800 L/dayQ = 0.8 m³/dayHydraulic volume = 0.8 × 1Hydraulic volume = 0.8 m³

Step 2. Find sludge and scum storage.

Storage = 10 × 0.04 × 2Storage = 0.8 m³Preliminary volume = 0.8 + 0.8Preliminary volume = 1.6 m³

Step 3. Check selected liquid volume.

Provided liquid volume = 2 × 1 × 1Provided liquid volume = 2.0 m³2.0 m³ > 1.6 m³

Final answer:

The trial liquid volume is 2.0 m³; it is not a complete septic design. Verify IS 2470 sizing, freeboard, compartments, inlet/outlet, ground conditions and safe effluent disposal.
